What We Tested

Internal playtest

The lab route was hard to read.

  • Turned the starting view toward the aisle
  • Spread four pages around the lab
  • Marked the old metal door as closed

Interaction check

Repair the skeleton to release a key.

Internal walkthrough

Lab entrance → Ritual → Level 1 ending

Main Design Problems

Visual Style

2D pixel art → first-person 3D
Third-person weakened immersion. First-person 2D felt too experimental.

Puzzle Level Design

Bring the setting, the puzzles, and the theme together.

Job’s Role

Job guides the player, then betrays them. Only selected puzzles require his help.

Current focus

Build a Sense of Horror

Use low-poly models and uncanny facial expressions. Explore props and sound effects to heighten the unease.
